coverage: Whole image once for layout, then supplied half a once and half b once line by line against both textual witnesses. Read upper-left reference and header, the complete first paragraph with all interlinear words, pen arrow, x cancellation, low mark, left tick and terminal deletion; the complete lower paragraph with overprint, inserted cf texte joint, compound cancellation and underlining, both typed additions, all live references and altered IV/5/ou V; all five slanted margin lines; final cancelled row, detached vertical stroke and archive number. Every margin was inspected. No source region remains unviewed; some initial marginal ink is physically clipped and remains doubtful. Seven unique tight crops were each emitted and inspected once, with the slanted note rotated before its view. No OCR, research, other page, other reader, repeated source view or compilation was used.

notes.text: The sheet bears typed VII 2, a handwritten upper-left reference SGA 4 with barred XVI, and an archival pencil 29 at bottom left. It has no visible date, salutation or signature on this sheet. The last item is recorded as an archival comment rather than manuscript pagination.
notes.basis: Observation: whole page, half a header and half b lower edge.

notes.text: The first paragraph says that 2.1.1 reduces to an affine X over S, calls that quasi-compact quasi-séparé/cohérent, and discusses replacing an appeal to the force of proper base change with a reduction through 2.1.5 and transcendence degree 1 to a statement about H^1 premier à p for a proper smooth curve. These are reported source claims; no cited theorem or reduction was independently checked.
notes.basis: Source assertion in first paragraph; no proof check. Local readings of every X, S, f, H, exponent 1, p and numbered reference were made directly from half a.

notes.text: The author proposes presenting the material this way in a re-edition of SGA 4. The source explicitly says s'il ne l'est déjà (je n'ai pas les textes en main), so the presence of the statement in the existing text is left uncertain by the author. No such presence has been verified in this run.
notes.basis: Observation: first paragraph from Je pense présenter through en main. The proposal and the author's uncertainty are not later outcomes.

notes.text: The live grouping advice joins 2.1.1 and 2.1.7, called practically identical, with 2.1.5, perhaps as a corollary. Later it says 2.12, 2.1.3, 2.1.4 and 2.1.7.1 have nothing to do with schemes and should pass to a separate number in IV or V. The missing dot in 2.12 and il sont are retained exactly. No equivalence or generality claim was mathematically checked.
notes.basis: Source assertion and local glyph observation: second paragraph and live lower continuation.

notes.text: The interlinear et qui est essentiellement is visibly incomplete. Corps de has a call before base; this reading follows the call rather than moving the words to cas du. The large lower cancellation and its pen paths are kept around their complete text, including the Au lieu sentence and its interlinear additions.
notes.basis: Observation: half a insertion positions and half b / crop 04 graphic geometry. No reconstruction from mathematical expectations.

notes.text: The marginal prefix remains tentative: si on utilise / ailleurs. Factorisation canonique d'un champ, with closing quote strokes and a comma, is substantially more readable. The physical source clips the starts of several diagonal lines. The report retains doubt rather than restoring missing initial ink.
